blocks.text: After years of waiting, the SWS Family in the Philippines is getting even more chances to see Sleeping With Sirens live! Due to overwhelming demand, SLEEPING WITH SIRENS ‘AN ENDING IN ITSELF TOUR ASIA 2027’ is adding a second show day in Manila, giving more Filipino fans the opportunity to experience the band’s highly anticipated return to the city. Presented by PULP Live World, the tour will now make four stops across three cities in Asia. The Asia tour will begin in Singapore on April 13, 2027 at the Capitol Theatre, followed by a stop at Zepp Kuala Lumpur in Malaysia […]...
